::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 3d 1889  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear [Miss Durton](people/person_458.qmd)

Your [Good Friday](other_books/otherbook_1076.qmd) has been a long time on its way, owing to the misdirection, but I have it now, and I wish I could have got it into the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) for Easter, though even if it had come direct it would not have been in time for April.

I am very glad to hear more of [Ottavia](other_books/otherbook_1075.qmd)’s family and will insert this when I can.[^1] Perhaps another time you had better write direct to me. My paper is so thick that I will only put in this one half sheet

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Both 'Ottavia' *MP* 3s 14 (July 1887),  87-96,  and 'A Good Friday Procession at Grassina'  *MP* 3s 19 (April 1890) 371-6, appeared under the name 'E.Vere'.   They purport to be real life accounts of Italian peasantry, and the author perhaps lived in Italy.
